steps.caption: Starting point: pattern 1 plays C3, D3, E3 and F3 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65). Open Channel tasks → Masks → Note. With no step held, the Note value is X, so each step uses its merged pattern note.
With no step held, turn E3 right until Note reads G3 (MIDI 67). All four steps now play G3 while retaining the source-pattern velocities.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: With no step held, turn E3 left until Note reads X. The channel mask is unset, so MIDI returns to the pattern's C3, D3, E3 and F3 notes at their original velocities.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop
